title: Application freezes when opening notification panel
description: The application becomes unresponsive when the notification panel is opened after a long period of inactivity. No useful stack trace is available from the client. The issue appears intermittently and is difficult to reproduce.
stack_trace: ERROR: Notification panel became unresponsive. Application stopped responding for approximately 18 seconds. No stack trace was captured. Browser console: [Warning] Long running task detected. [Warning] UI thread blocked. Reproduction: 1. Login to the application. 2. Leave the application idle for approximately 20 minutes. 3. Open the notification panel. 4. UI becomes unresponsive.
